Verb and idiom uses ('They part ways', 'take part': 0.26-0.38 of maximum) are its weakest 'part' firings, and its only other firings are a graded tail of subdivision/quantity nouns and the months May/March (step, issue, portion, branch, chapter, act, section, episode, volume, season, stage, unit, module, member, aspect, set, scene, lot, much) at 0.05-0.70 of maximum, i.e. the token neighbourhood of 'part', not a second feature.
